title: Cardinal Billing Account Standing Rule: Frequency Rate for Repeated Assisted Payments
content:
**Rule.** A frequency rate multiplies the representative payment fee on a Cardinal Billing Account assisted payment: **1.50** when three or more (3 or more) assisted payments were posted on the account in the last 12 whole months, **1.20** when one or two were, and **1.00** when none was.

An assisted payment is a payment posted through the phone representative channel, as shown by the payment entries on the account's billing history. A window of the last 12 whole months holds every record posted less than 12 whole months before the payment date, counted on calendar months. The payment being made is not yet posted and is not one of them.

| Assisted payments posted in the last 12 whole months | Frequency rate |
|---|---|
| 0 | 1.00 |
| 1 | 1.20 |
| 2 | 1.20 |
| 3 or more | 1.50 |

**Hypothetical cases.** Payments made online, by mail, by autopay or on the automated phone line are not assisted payments and are not counted. An account with two assisted payments in the window and a third posted 14 months before the payment date: 1.20.
